techs.description: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.

techs.description: A highly effective hull auto-repair system comprised of billions of microscopic nanomachines was found among the smoking remains of the Scavenger, and has been repurposed for our uses. techs.name: Starbase Construction
techs.description: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.

techs.name: Starport
techs.description: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.

techs.name: Starhold
techs.description: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

techs.name: Star Fortress
techs.description: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

techs.name: Citadel
techs.description: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

techs.name: Orbital Habitats
techs.description: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.

techs.name: Habitat Expansion
techs.description: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.

techs.name: Modular Engineering
techs.description: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.

techs.name: Corps of Engineers
techs.description: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

scripted.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Carrier Operations
techs.description: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

techs.name: Improved Strike Craft
techs.description: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

techs.name: Advanced Strike Craft
techs.description: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

techs.name: Skravird Strike Craft
techs.description: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

techs.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
techs.description: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.

techs.name: Nanocomposite Materials
techs.description: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

techs.name: Ceramo-Metal Materials
techs.description: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

techs.name: Plasteel Materials
techs.description: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

techs.name: Durasteel Materials
techs.description: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

techs.name: Neutronium Materials
techs.description: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

techs.name: Crystal-Infused Plating
techs.description: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.

techs.name: Crystal-Forged Plating
techs.description: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

techs.name: Armor Hardening
techs.description: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.

techs.name: Adaptive Armor Hardening
techs.description: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

techs.name: Chemical Thrusters
techs.description: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.

techs.name: Ion Thrusters
techs.description: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Plasma Thrusters
techs.description: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Impulse Thrusters
techs.description: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

techs.name: Deep Space Defenses
techs.description: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.

techs.name: Improved Structural Integrity
techs.description: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.

techs.name: Industrial Base
techs.description: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.

techs.name: Mechanized Mining
techs.description: The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.

techs.name: Powered Exoskeletons
techs.description: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.

techs.name: Zero-G Refineries
techs.description: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.

techs.name: Long-Range Mineral Scanners
techs.description: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.

techs.name: Mineral Cutting Beams
techs.description: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.

techs.name: Autonomous Mining Drones
techs.description: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.

techs.name: Nanite Mineral Probes
techs.description: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

techs.name: Geothermal Fracking
techs.description: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.

techs.name: Deep Core Mining
techs.description: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.

techs.name: Mineral Isolation
techs.description: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.

techs.description: With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!

techs.description: Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.

techs.name: Matter Compression
techs.description: Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.

techs.name: Loader Efficiency

techs.name: Assembly Algorithms
techs.description: The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.

techs.name: Mass Drivers
techs.description: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.

techs.name: Coilguns
techs.description: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.

techs.name: Railguns
techs.description: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.

techs.name: Advanced Railguns
techs.description: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

techs.name: Gauss Cannons
techs.description: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.

techs.name: Kinetic Battery
techs.description: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

techs.name: Kinetic Artillery
techs.description: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.

techs.name: Mega Cannon

techs.name: Giga Cannon
techs.description: An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.

techs.name: Autocannons
techs.description: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.

techs.name: Ripper Cannons

techs.name: Stormfire Cannons
techs.description: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

techs.name: Flak Battery
techs.description: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.

techs.name: Flak Cannons
techs.description: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.

techs.name: Flak Artillery
techs.description: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

techs.name: Nuclear Missiles
techs.description: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.

techs.name: Quantum Missiles

techs.description: The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.

techs.name: Interstellar Commerce Nexus

techs.name: Extra-Dimensional Depot

techs.name: Omni-Bliss Nexus
techs.description: A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.

techs.name: Quantum Innovation Nexus

techs.name: Arkship Construction
techs.description: Our society need not be limited to one home. With the ability to construct additional Arkships, every direction becomes a path, and every path becomes ours.

techs.name: Arkship Engineering
techs.description: Refined structural design and improved drive systems allow for a new generation of Arkships: carrying more of who we are, further than we have ever gone.

techs.name: Arkship Mastery
techs.description: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

techs.name: Civilian Arkships
techs.description: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

techs.name: Scientific Arkships
techs.description: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

techs.name: Military Arkships

techs.name: Planetary Reprocessor

techs.description: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.

techs.name: Quantum Probes
techs.description: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.

techs.name: Autonomous Station Protocols
techs.description: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.

techs.name: Multi-Dimensional Analysis
techs.description: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.

techs.name: Quantum Computing
techs.description: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

techs.name: Unified Field Theory
techs.description: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

techs.name: Quantum Gravitational Waves
techs.description: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

techs.name: Administrative AI
techs.description: Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.

techs.name: Automated Colony Ships
techs.description: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

techs.name: Self-Aware Colony Ships
techs.description: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

techs.name: Self-Evolving Logic
techs.description: Introspective prioritization.

techs.name: Automated Exploration Protocols
techs.description: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.

techs.name: Positronic AI
techs.description: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

techs.name: Positronic Implants
techs.description: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.

techs.name: Specialized Combat Computers
techs.description: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.

techs.name: Simultaneous-Collapse Storage

techs.name: Negative-Time Keys
techs.description: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.

techs.name: Quantum Hacking
techs.description: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

techs.name: Simulated Social Engineering
techs.description: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

techs.name: Quasi-Dimensional Reflection
techs.description: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

techs.name: Fission Power
techs.description: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.

techs.name: Fusion Power
techs.description: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.

techs.name: Cold Fusion Power
techs.description: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Antimatter Power
techs.description: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

techs.name: Zero Point Power
techs.description: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

techs.name: Reactor Boosters
techs.description: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.

techs.name: Improved Reactor Boosters
techs.description: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.

techs.name: Advanced Reactor Boosters
techs.description: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.

techs.name: Deflectors
techs.description: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.

techs.name: Improved Deflectors
techs.description: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

techs.name: Shields
techs.description: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

techs.name: Advanced Shields
techs.description: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

techs.name: Hyper Shields
techs.description: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

techs.name: Shield Capacitors
techs.description: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.

techs.name: Shield Hardening
techs.description: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.

techs.name: Advanced Shield Hardening
techs.description: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.

techs.name: Planetary Shields
techs.description: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

techs.name: Gravitic Sensors
techs.description: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

techs.name: Subspace Sensors
techs.description: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

techs.name: Tachyon Sensors
techs.description: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

techs.name: High-Energy Capacitors
techs.description: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.

techs.name: Field Modulation
techs.description: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.

techs.name: Quantum Energy States
techs.description: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.

techs.name: Quantum Field Manipulation
techs.description: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.

techs.name: FTL Inhibition
techs.description: Gravity well projectors can be used to create localized pockets of space where safe entry into hyperspace is impossible. The immense power requirements and the size of the projectors prohibits their use on anything smaller than a space station.

techs.name: Applied Superconductivity
techs.description: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.

techs.name: Shield Harmonics
techs.description: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.

techs.name: Focusing Arrays
techs.description: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.

techs.name: Flash Coolant
techs.description: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.

techs.name: Gravitational Analysis
techs.description: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.

techs.name: Red Lasers
techs.description: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.

techs.name: Blue Lasers
techs.description: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.

techs.name: UV Lasers
techs.description: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

techs.name: X-Ray Lasers
techs.description: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

techs.name: Gamma Lasers
techs.description: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

techs.name: Particle Lances
techs.description: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

techs.name: Tachyon Lances
techs.description: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

techs.name: Plasma Throwers
techs.description: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.

techs.name: Plasma Accelerators
techs.description: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

techs.name: Plasma Cannons
techs.description: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

techs.name: Arc Emitters
techs.description: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

techs.name: Focused Arc Emitters
techs.description: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

techs.name: Disruptors
techs.description: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.

techs.name: Ion Disruptors
techs.description: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

techs.name: Phase Disruptors
techs.description: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

techs.name: Proton Launchers
techs.description: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

techs.name: Neutron Launchers
techs.description: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

techs.name: Active Countermeasures
techs.description: The best defense is a good offense.

techs.description: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships.

techs.description: Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand colony ships, confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.

techs.description: By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.

techs.description: Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.

techs.description: Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.

techs.description: Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.

techs.name: Tomb World Adaptation
techs.description: Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.

condition.text: Has Ascension Perk: Mastery of Nature

condition.text: Has Ascension Perk: Mastery of Nature

techs.description: Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.

condition.text: Has Ascension Perk: Mastery of Nature

techs.description: Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.

condition.text: Has Ascension Perk: Mastery of Nature

techs.name: Tetradimensional Engineering
techs.description: When a structure gets too large and too complex, no amount of support will ever be able to prevent it from collapsing on itself. It therefore becomes necessary to make use of constructs rooted within higher dimensions in order to stabilize these colossal gigastructures. This paves the way for many innovative technologies, such as the ability to fit more matter in a given volume without it collapsing into a black hole, and to be able to defy gravity on unimaginable scales. This also allows for the creation of materials capable of withstanding absolutely ridiculous amounts of stress.

techs.name: Gravitational Accretion Compression
techs.description: The Hyperquasar at the galactic core is surrounded by a massive and extremely energetic accretion disk. This disk obviously makes it impossible to assemble anything in the quasar's vicinity. However, by altering the gravitational constant near the quasar, we could effectively simulate an increase in the object's mass, which would force the disk to shrink to a smaller size. This would in effect both increase its energetic potential, and allow us to construct a structure much closer to the quasar.

techs.description: One of the supermassive quasar's most prominent feature is the presence of two gigantic jets, consisting of hyperaccelerated jets of ionised matter shooting out from both poles at relativistic speeds. If we combine several incredibly advanced technologies, from strong force manipulation to gravity stabilization, it becomes possible to upscale the Attack Moon (~3000km) to a much, much larger body (~15000km). Such an incredibly massive spaceship would be near-indestructible, and could wipe out entire Fallen Empires by itself.

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Storage Applications
techs.description: By employing tetradimensional engineering in our storage designs, we can effectively store more resources in the same volume of space.

techs.name: Modular Megastructure Designs
techs.description: Implementing a higher degree of modular engineering into our megastructure schematics will help streamline their construction.

techs.name: Theoretical Stellarscale Propulsion
techs.description: If we wish to weaponize an entire solar system, we must figure out how exactly a star could be moved alongside its planets. Studies into ridiculously-large methods of propulsion will surely yield valuable insight on this problem.

techs.name: Relativistic Singularity Harvesting
techs.description: Black Holes, despite emitting very little energy themselves, are actually energetic powerhouses. The combination of several advanced energy-harvesting methods, adapted to fit around a massive black hole, could let us assemble an extremely efficient machine to completely monopolize all the energy the black hole has to offer.

techs.name: Gigascale Stellar Computing
techs.description: In order to fulfill our ever-growing needs for computing power, we must think bigger. By incorporating a dyson sphere-like design into a larger array of computing structures, we could construct a massive system-spanning computer consisting of multiple nested layers feeding off each other's heat.

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Shielding
techs.description: Quasars are incredible energetic objects. If we wish to undertake any sort of engineering projects in their vicinity, it will be necessary to develop advanced shielding to protect our structures from the quasar's gravitational pull and radiation.

techs.name: The Birch World
techs.description: The Birch World was only a theoretical artificial construct intended for the most expansive of habitations, but it is now a reality. Built around the largest of black holes, these spacious shell worlds are specially made as to be built upon the event horizon of said black holes, at which level the surface gravity is comparable to the gravity of our home world.

techs.name: Behemoth Ringworld Construction
techs.description: Our overgrowing populous requires miles of urban and rural land that most systems cannot provide. Perhaps it's time for a third ring.

techs.name: Event Horizon Offset Facility Hyperscaling
techs.description: The culmination of E.H.O.F. development coupled with the latest advancements in gigastructural engineering. This monstrous construct, built around the largest of black holes, is theoretically capable of generating a near-infinite amount of microwormholes anywhere within the galaxy, enabling both never-seen-before mobility for our fleets as well as the drastic curbing of most distance-related logistical issues inherent to our empire's size.

techs.name: Ancient Spacetime Manipulation Data
techs.description: Data from Pouchkinn's Ancient Laboratory provides us with incredible insights on the nature of spacetime.

techs.name: Quasi-Neural Networks
techs.description: The discoveries made through the study of the planet-plant brain led to the development of artificial quasi-neural networks. These allow us to perform alternate and unknown methods of data-transmission and data-management in various application areas.

techs.name: Ancient Lifespan Extension Data
techs.description: Analyzing the recovered bioimplants from the lone scientist's body will be a great boon to our longevity research.

techs.name: Scourge Deployment
techs.description: The Scarlet Scourge is an advanced synthetic toxin that could either be used as a terraforming agent, as originally intended, or as a planet-enveloping chemical weapon capable of destroying all life. Its use is up to us.

techs.name: Katzen Atomic Munitions
techs.description: The extremely militaristic and nuclear-loving Katzens have managed to destroy the surfaces of both Katzenland and Flusion with remarkable ease and efficiency. They seemed to employ a vast array of different explosives in order to deal as much damage as possible, ranging from radioactive fission warheads, to antimatter bombs, and biochemical weaponry. By adopting their methods, our ships could be made to completely devastate enemy worlds with ease.

techs.name: Unconventional Macroengineering Methods
techs.description: By analyzing the data from the odd Squareworld, we can learn a great deal about eccentric construction techniques and outside-the-box engineering.

techs.name: Negative Mass Enhancements
techs.description: The Compound is a threat to all life in the galaxy, and possibly even beyond. Our tests have shown that negative mass is the only thing we know of that can harm them. From this lead, we have begun to develop energy weapons that employ negative mass so that we can finally fight back.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Tier I
techs.description: The first generation of Sentient Metal technology was developed through intensive study of the Enigmatic Pattern transmitters and Primordial Pillars. It is focused on an industrial structure that will replicate Sentient Metal.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Intellect
techs.description: The capacities of the Sentient Metal hive mind are tremendous and far beyond even our most powerful information processing networks. By directly connecting it to the systems of our ships and structures, we can implement superordinate orders for it to control our ships and stations like no other ship computer before.

techs.name: Negative Mass Sensors
techs.description: Negative mass allows us to augment our existing sensors by creating much more precise signal filters, resulting in improved scan resolution and fleet detection.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Armor
techs.description: Sentient metal reconstitutes and replicates when damaged, dynamically adapting to environmental effects. This makes it a perfect substance for armor.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Hull Regeneration
techs.description: By constructing the hulls of our ships out of material which contain traces of sentient metal and material reservoirs, our ships can self-repair with extreme efficiency.

children.text: Has technology: Sentient Metal Hull Regeneration

techs.name: Negative Mass Shields
techs.description: Negative mass shields actively repel matter and energy striking them rather than simply dissipating the source at its point of impact.

techs.name: Negative Mass Thrusters
techs.description: Research into negative mass has allowed us to expand its usage within our empire. The substance's exotic properties theoretically allow for non-hyperdrive based FTL travel, but the more mundane properties of our ship architecture mean that we have to settle for thrusters that simply go really, really fast.

techs.name: Negative Mass Reactors
techs.description: Negative mass reactors utilize polarized flows of the substance and \"normal\" energy to achieve near-perfect annihilation and commiserately massive power output.

techs.name: Negative Mass Jump Drive Enhancements
techs.description: The Jump Drive is already an unbelievable invention on its own, but with the unique properties of negative mass, we were able to enhance it even further! By infusing a ship with the substance at the moment of a jump, we can massively reduce the vessel's mass, and consequently, the amount of energy required to translate it across space. This allows us to travel farther and more routinely on the same basic Jump Drive design.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Flak Battery
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Flak Battery utilizes the material's local network intelligence to aim more precisely and accurately at incoming projectiles than we were ever able before.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Ripper
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Ripper shoots numerous tiny sentient metal spikes, each programmed to assimilate any form of matter they come into contact with, then condensing into a sphere and disconnecting from its point of contact.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Railgun
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Railgun amalgamates and then fires a small sentient metal spike programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Once the projectile reaches a certain threshold of absorbed material, it condenses into a sphere and decouples.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Artillery
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Artillery amalgamates and then fires a large spike of Sentient Metal programmed to absorb any form of matter it comes into contact with. Fighters and small ships are immediately assimilated; larger ships sustain heavy damage as sentient metal rips chunks out of their hull.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Absorber
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Absorber launches enormous Sentient Metal spikes, often large enough to fully assimilate smaller ships in a single shot.

techs.name: Sentient Metal Devourer
techs.description: The Sentient Metal Devourer doesn't directly utilize sentient metal to damage its targets. Rather, it uses the material's connection to the Everchanging, along with the Enigmatic Pattern, to have the Everchanging open a power transfer micro wormhole. It directs the resultant colossal outpouring of energy towards enemy vessels.

techs.name: Negative Mass Point Defense
techs.description: The Negative Mass Point Defense fires an expanding wave of negative mass towards incoming projectiles, throwing them off-course.

techs.name: Negative Mass Laser
techs.description: The Negative Mass Laser employs a focused negative mass conduit to decohere any form of matter, baryonic or otherwise.

techs.name: Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher
techs.description: The Negative Mass Pseudoplasma Launcher fires coherent spheres of negative mass that explosively disrupt any form of matter they strike.

techs.name: Negative Mass Disruptor
techs.description: The Negative Mass Disruptor fires waves of tremendously destructive negative mass which decohere large swathes of matter. Unfortunately, these waves dissipate after a short distance.

techs.name: Negative Mass Torpedoes
techs.description: Negative Mass Torpedoes use the repulsive force of negative mass to amplify the destructive power of our packed neutron warheads.

techs.name: Negative Mass Lance
techs.description: The Negative Mass Lance fires a continuous ray of negative mass, tearing apart even the most reinforced material defenses at the subatomic (or equivalent) level.

techs.name: Negative Mass Emitter
techs.description: The Negative Mass Emitter fires a scatter-shot of randomly polarized and spun negative mass rays, to which dedicated defenses are nothing but more hull.

techs.name: Negative Mass Beam
techs.description: The Negative Mass Beam is a titanic focused ray that decoheres vast swathes of matter in a single hit.

techs.name: Abstract Physics Theory
techs.description: Some exotic physical phenomena may not be explainable with quantum-theoretical or string-theoretical approaches alone. A new branch of physics called \"Abstract Physics\", which makes use of extremely unconventional methods and approaches, may lead to answers for even the most absurd phenomena of the universe and beyond.

techs.name: E.H.O.F. Alpha
techs.description: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator and squeezed electromagnetic fields to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. Due to their indeterministic behavior, their destinations are largely beyond our control.

techs.name: Applied Abstract Physics
techs.description: The extremely efficient approaches of abstract physics are aiding us well in explaining even the universe's most bizarre phenomena. Using these approaches to find novel breakthroughs may give us access to unique and powerful technologies.

techs.name: Photonic Matter Utilization
techs.description: The ability to precisely manipulate electromagnetic wave interference patterns has allowed us to construct stable standing waves capable of interaction with the physical world in ways resembling mundane matter. This \"photonic\" matter shows great promise in micro-scale manipulation tasks, and will be invaluable in the field of shield harmonics.

techs.name: Negative Pressure Application
techs.description: Negative pressure is a phenomenon that has been observed before at the quantum level, in the form of the Casimir effect. There, it manifests in form of vacuum fluctuations, but is uncontrollable. Applied abstract physics has lead to the discovery of better-applicable and more efficient ways to generate and control negative pressure.

techs.name: E.H.O.F. Lambda
techs.description: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes. The photonic matter and negative pressure enhance the entire process, increasing the Event Horizon Offset Facility's precision and expanding its range of destinations.

techs.name: Horizon Drive
techs.description: This device, mounted on the spine of an Arkship, utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, squeezed electromagnetic fields, photonic matter, and negative pressure to inflate and stabilize micro wormholes.

techs.name: Quoudroplean Formalism
techs.description: As abstract physics is very different to other branches of physics, it necessitates customized mathematical formalism to efficiently express it. This \"Quoudroplean Formalism\" makes use of truly alien mathematical frameworks and theorems that don't fit into the classical universe of mathematics and were thought to be entirely inapplicable and inadequate for reality.

techs.name: Unorthodox Reality Examination Techniques
techs.description: The unconventional approaches and principles of abstract physics require the construction of new research facilities to develop alternative investigation methods for the comprehension of reality.

techs.name: Negative Energy Studies
techs.description: Negative energy has been a purely hypothetical, controversial, and extremely abstract topic for a long time... at least until the discovery of the mind-bending negative mass. Abstract physics will allow us to further study this seemingly impossible, yet undeniably real, phenomenon.

scripted.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Sterile Hyper-Neutrino Detection
techs.description: A unique form of exotic dark matter originating from hyperspace, sterile hyper-neutrinos radiate from the opening of micro wormholes. They possess unique frequencies related to the location that the micro wormholes lead to. By analyzing these frequencies, we can predict the target of an micro wormhole with much higher precision, increasing the accuracy of our Event Horizon Offset Facility.

techs.name: Hardlight Construct Utilization
techs.description: Dominion over the electromagnetic field will grant us the ability to create pure hardlight constructs, advanced and powerful extensions of photonic matter. These constructs will be able to directly manipulate elementary particles and thus provide even further control of matter and energy.

techs.name: Prototype Negative Mass Utilities
techs.description: The first generation of devices, processes and methods that utilize negative mass. They are still experimental prototypes and don't utilize the full potential of negative mass, but are powerful nonetheless.

children.text: Has technology: Prototype Negative Mass Utilities

techs.name: E.H.O.F. Omega
techs.description: Utilizes the Arcane Rift Manipulator, hardlight constructs, sterile sub-neutrino detectors, and negative mass to manipulate and inflate micro wormholes. The utilization of negative mass induces total stabilization of wormholes, which allows us to keep the inflated micro wormholes open for as long as we see fit. The sterile sub-neutrino detectors further expand the range of destinations our micro wormholes can reach.

potential.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Non-paradoxical Information Supercausality
techs.description: The transportation of information, matter and energy in non-abstract physics is strictly bound to the speed of causality, which in itself is limited and relatively small compared to the size of the universe. Faster-than-causality transmission can only be achieved in circumstances where no information is transmitted or spacetime is bent. However, in abstract physics, the boundaries between fixed rules and unfixed potentialities are themselves fluid and shifting. There are certain ways to work around these rules, change them, or even simply ignore them. As absurd as it may appear.

techs.name: Supercausal Research Initiatives
techs.description: The supercausal phenomena of abstract physics require their own kind of advanced, complex, and powerful research facilities.

techs.name: Advanced Negative Mass Utilities
techs.description: The potential of negative mass is vast. A deeper understanding of this bizarre resource enables the development and creation of even more advanced and powerful negative mass assets.

children.text: Has technology: Advanced Negative Mass Utilities

techs.name: Micro Wormhole Destination Precognition
techs.description: Unimaginably sensitive tachyon sensors, based on and aided by the astonishing capabilities of the sentient metal hive-intellect, determine the target of a micro wormhole before it even emerges in real space. This prediction of wormhole targets increases the precision of Event Horizon Offset Facility travel to a seemingly impossible degree. With this technology, our Event Horizon Offset Facility will be able to form a micro wormhole connecting it to any destination in the galaxy.

techs.name: Electroweak Quasi-Field Materialization
techs.description: Extremely high energy states lead to the unification of the electromagnetic and weak forces into their initial force, the electroweak force. The secrets of the Everchanging revealed how to manifest physical \"Electroweak Quasi-Fields\", which open up possibilities for tremendously precise field and spacetime manipulation, even down to the level of quantum foam itself.

techs.name: E.H.O.F. Ultima
techs.description: Utilizing the mysteries of the Everchanging, the E.H.O.F. Ultima is the perfect form of the Event Horizon Offset Facility, capable of traveling to any location of our choosing without limitations and risks. Limitless possibilities await.

techs.name: Decay Particle Kinetic Energy Extraction
techs.description: High energy pair-annihilation processes are not 100% efficient. The more massive an annihilated particle pair, the more likely the output is less massive particles rather than photons. A new generation of power plants make use of abstract physics to extract the kinetic energy of these decay particles to further increase the efficiency of antimatter-matter annihilation energy generation processes.

techs.name: Passive Zero-Point Energy Siphoning
techs.description: Besides the generation of power via active zero-point energy siphoning utilized in reactors, we can use a passive method of siphoning in specialized power plants. This enables us the extraction of zero-point energy in regular power plants, increasing their efficiency beyond 100%.

techs.name: Gravitational Wave Energy Extraction
techs.description: Gravitational waves may be extremely hard to detect, but they contain tremendous amounts of energy. Even small masses release large amounts of gravitational energy in form of these waves. Advanced abstract physics techniques allow us to directly extract energy from gravitational waves, thus making a new generation of reactors and power plants possible.

techs.name: Light Conduction Distribution Systems
techs.description: High-energy laser conduction energy distributors allow for interplanetary energy transport and exchange, increasing the efficiency of our empire's power distribution.

techs.name: Hyperlane Power Transmission
techs.description: Advances in abstract physics enable the development of ultra-high-capacity hyperlane power transmitters that allow for fast and efficient interstellar energy transmission.

techs.name: Field Entanglement Energy Transregulation
techs.description: The discovery of non-paradoxical supercausality has led to the development of an immensely efficient and powerful energy distributor. This system utilizes field entanglement energy transregulation to transport tremendous amounts of energy from anywhere to everywhere.

techs.name: Negative Mass Protector
techs.description: By creating a mass-energy repulsive layer around a planet's atmosphere through the utilization of Negative Mass, this structure shields a planet from even the most intense orbital bombardment. Only long-term bombardment and extremely high energy beams can penetrate the repulsive layer in time.

techs.name: Katzen Celestial Body Weaponization
techs.description: The study of the Kaiser Moon has allowed us to recreate the superweapon's blueprints. With much heavier armaments than a regular Attack Moon, the Kaiser Moon is a fearsome superweapon that would undoubtedly dominate the stellar battlefield.

techs.name: Esoteric Katzen Weaponry
techs.description: The study of the Stellarite Kaiser Moon has yielded some insight on what it is made out of. It seems to be built from a material containing ridiculous energies, which allowed the Stellarite Kaiser Moon to boast exceedingly powerful weapons. We are still uncertain as to how or why the Kaiser was able to acquire the necessary resources to build one, though.

techs.name: The Infinity Project
techs.description: Extensive studies of the Improbable Kaiser Moon has borne some limited fruit. Though we cannot fully understand the physics behind it, it seems to follow certain theoretical aspects of higher-dimensional engineering. This is what allowed it to fuel its huge array of weaponry, and our limited ability to reproduce it will allow us to construct replicates. No-one is sure how the Kaiser came across this knowledge before our own greatest minds, though.

techs.name: Katzen Weakpoint Analysis
techs.description: By further studying Katzen ship engineering, we can locate weakpoints within their designs, which can then be exploited to facilitate their destruction. Enigmatic Engineering will completely nullify any risks of the Kaiser finding out about our plans.

techs.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Analysis

techs.name: Long-Term Blokkat Scrap Weaponization
techs.description: A slower and more careful approach to our utilization of Blokkat Scrap in our own vessels will yield more permanent results. The scrap can most notably be used to figure out ways to assault Blokkat vessels and structures from multiple dimensions at once.

techs.name: Planck-Dismantlement Beam
techs.description: The Planck-Dismantlement Beam is a Blokkat device based on their stripmining apparatuses. Not only do these devices systematically dismantle the very fabric of enemy ships down to the subplanck level, reducing them to a slurry of hypercondensed quantum foam, they also collect said foam and store it aboard Blokkat vessels, where it can later be reprocessed into usable materials.

techs.name: Tetradimensional Singularity Cannon
techs.description: These advanced launchers catapult a seeking four-dimensional singularity towards enemy ships. While they appear detached from Blokkat ships, these singularities are actually more akin to "lassos", as they are connected to Blokkat vessels through a higher dimension and are later "reeled back" by said vessels through this higher dimension after plowing through enemy ships. This enables the Blokkats to collect whatever the singularities destroyed and process it for later usage.

techs.name: Blokk-Swarmer Units
techs.description: These spaceborne units heavily resemble actual Blokkats themselves and are geared for spaceship combat. They are most often remotely controlled by Blokkats within the mothership and are even sometimes Blokkats.

techs.name: Planckalloy Plating
techs.description: These extremely tough armor platings are made up of tightly-packed Planck length-sized particles. They form complex subatomic neural structures allowing the material to autonomously react to changes and adapt accordingly near-instantaneously.

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Shiftbarrier
techs.description: Much like the Blokkat-Vester's humongous shield, these smaller protective barriers rotate within a higher dimension, meaning only an infinitely small chunk of the full shield is ever exposed to enemy fire at once. If it is damaged, the damaged area is instantly shifted back into hyperdimensional space to be regenerated.

techs.name: Blokk-Guardian Point-Defence System
techs.description: These hyperefficient point-defence systems shatter the very fabric of reality around enemy projectiles, obliterating them before they even get close to Blokkat vessels.

techs.name: Absolute Scorch Blaster
techs.description: The Absolute Scorch Blaster fires a glob of plasma heated to the Planck Temperature, which is practically the highest possible temperature under known models of physics. The plasma is kept to these extreme temperatures by a constant influx of energy through a higher dimension and matter which comes in contact with the plasma is \"absorbed\" into said dimension, converted into energy in a way similar to how Blokkats harvest star systems and then fueled back into the plasma to further sustain the projectile's heat.

techs.name: Pentafocused Emitter
techs.description: The Pentafocused emitter is a titanic piercing weapon of Blokkat design, which is capable of \"leaping\" through a higher dimension in order to bypass the shielding and armor of energy vessels.

techs.name: Evictor Ray
techs.description: The Evictor Ray is the largest Blokkat weapon encountered so far. This beam of untold power tears reality asunder and forcefully compresses its target into a 0-dimensional object by focusing the energies of several higher dimensions onto a localized area of the spacetime continuum, destroying it instantly.

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Capacitor
techs.description: Reactor boosters drawing additional energy from a higher-dimensional source. They also serve to improve the efficiency of the vessel as a whole.

techs.name: Manifold Thrusters
techs.description: In addition to their esoteric FTL thrusters, Blokkat vessels employ these thrusters which push against the very fabric of our universe in order to boost the speed of their crafts even further.

techs.name: Subplanck Synchronizers
techs.description: Swarms of miniscule robots that serve as relays for the neural networks contained within Blokkat armors, increasing their efficiency and enabling them to repair faster. Blokkat models also transmit data to and from the Blokkwork for increased synchronization.

techs.name: Blokkat Phaseshift Transportation
techs.description: There is no effective difference between a Blokkat thruster and a Blokkat FTL drive. They both employ a sort of device anchored through a higher dimension which quite literally \"drags\" the space surrounding the ship and moves it around with instantaneous acceleration.

techs.name: Blokkat Reactor
techs.description: Blokkat ships are powered by these mysterious constructs that draw untold amounts of energy transferred from a higher dimension.

techs.name: Blokkat Shipbound Computers
techs.description: The application of Blokkat technologies to the artificial intelligence of our vessels will enable us to create truly terrifying vessels of war.

techs.name: Hyperbrane Sensors
techs.description: These Blokkat-designed sensors look for the oscillations that 3-dimensional matter creates within the higher-dimensional manifold of the universe.

techs.name: Early Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Schematics
techs.description: The Hyperdimensional Stabilizer shall be one of the largest megastructures ever conceived, built for the sole purpose of bringing down the Blokkat-Vester's shield. Designing an appropriate construction site is a crucial step in the assembly of this colossal construct.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Construction Site

techs.name: Pentadimensional Power Sources
techs.description: A special black hole employing methods very much like that of the Blokkats could be used to power the mighty Hyperdimensional Destabilizer and effectively enable it to strike at the Blokkats' seemingly unbreakable shield.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Megastructure: Hyperdimensional Destabilizer Pentadimensional Converter

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Branebreaking
techs.description: By "skewing" the higher dimensions employed by the Blokkat Hyperdimensional Bulwark, we can forcefully bring it down one dimension, thus bringing it within the reach of our Pentadimensional Singularity.

techs.name: Yottascale Energy Manipulation
techs.description: Manipulating the sheer flow of energy required to bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark will require an untold number of higher-dimensional structures coupled with femtosecond-precision when it comes to executing the full sequence.

techs.name: Applied Hypertemporal Chronodisruption
techs.description: The ability to strike at a target from both the past, the future and higher dimensions will ensure we can bring down the Hyperdimensional Bulwark down with much greater ease than before. Additionally, the wider application of this technology to our weapons systems will noticeably increase their potential damage output.

techs.name: Blokkwork Severing Protocols
techs.description: By severing individual Blokkats' connection to the Blokkwork and neutralizing them, we might be able to ultimately contain them provided we possess the necessary infrastructure to deny their escape. This will require the construction of a specialized holding cell surrounding the Blokkat within hyperdimensional space.

techs.name: Temporal Restoration

techs.name: Hyperdimensional Linguistics
techs.description: Blokkat language revolves on an incredibly complex set of energy waves entangled within higher dimensions, transmitted across intergalactic distances through the Blokkwork. Managing to truly understand this language would surely let us establish closer relations with these beings.

techs.name: Blokkilian Equations - Energy Primacy
techs.description: The Blokkats have long since converted their technologies to be based on the most fundamental aspect of the universe: energy. They utilize the Blokkwork to transfer vast quantities of energy across great distances and subsequently shape this energy into whatever they may require. Understanding how to base an entire civilization on the universe's most basic resource is paramount to solving the Blokkilian Equations.

techs.name: Blokkilian Equations - Intergalactic Logistics
techs.description: How to properly coordinate harvesting operations spread over a significant portion of the observable universe involving the mass-energy of several galaxies being shipped across intergalactic distances? When one is running an operation as large as that of the Blokkats, inefficiency is simply unacceptable and logistics must thus be refined to perfection.

techs.name: Blokkilian Equations - Planckscale Particle Generation
techs.description: It is a known fact that the Blokkats no longer rely on baryonic matter to function, instead utilizing raw energy to create new types of elementary particles better fit for their operations. These particles can thus be extremely small and allow for their devices to be much, much denser than ones built using conventional particles. If we are to understand how they achieved such a feat, we must study how the Blokkats utilize the Blokkwork to spontaneously generate particles capable of projecting their will down to the Planck scale.

techs.name: Blokkwork Power Nodes - Direct Blokkwork Connection
techs.description: With our newfound understanding of Blokkat technology granted by the Blokkilian Equations, we are now ready to truly prepare our ascension by establishing the necessary infrastructure to connect ourselves to the Blokkwork. Although these power nodes will not let us access the full extent of the Blokkwork for now (as it is not yet completely established over our galaxy), they will nonetheless let us greatly streamline our planetary operations by generating our own Blokkwork across our empire.

techs.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Hyperbranic Frame
techs.description: The Pylon's frame is to be an intricate 6-dimensional construct embedded into the fabric of reality itself. Such a degree of sophistication is required if we are to bring the Blokkwork's full power into our galaxy.

techs.name: Blokkwork Pylon - Dimensional Power Core
techs.description: The Pylon's Power Core shall provide a direct link to the Blokkwork itself and enable the flow of near endless energy from the Blokkwork to our Blokkwork Power Node network.

techs.description: Improving support equipment and infrastructure for our planetary expeditions allows them to more effectively identify resource extraction opportunities.

techs.name: Applied Supertensiles
techs.description: Improved methods of molecular synthesis allow the practical application of materials with nigh-unimaginable tensile strength.

techs.name: Living Metal Infusion Process
techs.description: The regenerative properties of living metal could theoretically be exploited to improve the quality and output of our molecular foundries.

children.text: Has technology: Living Metal Infusion Process

techs.name: Sentient Metal Industrial Nanocomputing
techs.description: Processing equipment incorporating the nanoscale computing capacity of sentient metal could lead to dramatic improvements in molecular foundry throughput.

children.text: Has technology: Sentient Metal Industrial Nanocomputing

techs.name: Zero-G Molecular Cleanroom Design
techs.description: Dedicated processing spaces for Supertensile Materials on our orbital rings have the potential to boost local extraction and processing operations significantly.

children.text: Has technology: Zero-G Molecular Cleanroom Design

techs.name: Nano-Assembler
techs.description: Huge molecular synthesis arrays work in tandem with replicator bays to process raw minerals into materials for orbital construction.

techs.name: Polyatomic Crucible
techs.description: These facilities twist gravity to bind atoms into stable arrangements once thought impossible.

techs.name: Dark Matter Infused Supertensile Production
techs.description: Dark matter based hard light systems have the potential to revolutionize molecular synthesis.

techs.name: Alpha Project Megaconstruction Methodology
techs.description: Analysis of precursor material designs has led us to new heights in molecular manufacturing.

techs.name: Runic Matter Manipulation Techniques
techs.description: The esoteric properties of runic power promise significant improvements in the field of megaconstruction.

techs.name: Applied Mass Stellar Fusion
techs.description: Our mastery over stellarite lets us remake the world as we see fit, down to the sub-atomic level.

techs.name: Semithaumaturgic Crystalline Weaponry
techs.description: Faust's inhabitants have devised rifles and weapons infused with powerful crystals which far surpass conventional weaponry. While it might have appeared to be magic to them, which drastically limited just how much they could propagate the technology, a thorough study into the nature of these crystals might just enable us to standardize their usage within our armed forces. This would however entail a significant Rare Crystal upkeep cost.

techs.name: Industrial Psicatalyzed Fusion
techs.description: Replicating the esoteric workings of Helios' infernal core within a controlled environment and on an industrial scale enables tremendous energy production and the facilitated production of heavy elements.

techs.name: Thaumaturgic Enthrallment
techs.description: Studying how the Sirens unleash their enthralling spell could have great application for our government and society.

techs.name: Early Sirens Countermeasures
techs.description: While the deeper nature of the Sirens' mysterious song still eludes us, preliminary studies suggest that firing focused discharges of energy at specific frequencies into quasi-space can mitigate some of the Strife Field's effects, at the cost of drastically increasing the upkeep of the ships these mechanisms are mounted on.

techs.name: Disenchanter Tuning
techs.description: More careful attuning of the Disenchanter mechanisms allow for more efficient countering of the Strife Field's nefarious effects.

techs.name: Subpsionic Symphonies
techs.description: Breakthroughs in our understand of the Strife Field's enable us to directly emit counter-melodies to the Sirens' songs within the Immaterium itself, which can ward off even the nefarious Inner Field's mind-controlling effects.

unlocks.name: Allows capture of Starbases and Planets in the Inner Field.

techs.name: Euphonic Strife Dissipation
techs.description: Our understanding of the Sirens' song has now progressed to the point where we can comfortably nullify their mind-controlling field at any scale, albeit at a non-negligible energy cost.

techs.name: Harass Decoys
techs.description: Instead of being more conventional assault strike crafts, these high-health fighters exist only to overwhelm, harass and disorient enemy strike craft and PD systems, thus helping our other weapons inflict more damage.

techs.name: Crystalline Autocannon
techs.description: These autocannons spray a flurry of razor-sharp thaumaturgic crystals which, while they struggle to puncture thick armor and are generally stopped clean by shields, can absolutely devastate the more fragile hull of energy starships if it happens to be exposed.

techs.name: Crystalline Artillery
techs.description: These artilleries fire large crystalline projectiles imbued with excess psionic energy rendering them somewhat unstable and thus very effective against general enemy defenses.

techs.name: Thaumaturgic Charge
techs.description: This unorthodox missile design relies on a ball of charged thaumaturgic crystals lobbed through the void of space. Guided by a partial sentience wishing only to see the destruction of its opponents, it can slip through shields and armor alike in order to cause maximum carnage upon its beloathed foes.

techs.name: Crystalline Impactor
techs.description: The Crystalline Impactor relies on thaumaturgic crystals imbued with partial sentience in order to produce devastating seeking projectiles at extremely high velocities meant to damage and penetrate armor.

techs.name: Grand Void Beam
techs.description: This gargantuan beam has the interest effect of psionically-maximizing the entropy of its target, rendering it very efficient against shielding systems.

techs.name: Supercharged Thaumaturgic Weaponry
techs.description: The esoteric nature of thaumaturgic weaponry means there is essentially no upper limit on their potential. As long as more energy can be pumped in alongside more crystals to carry that energy, they can continue getting more and more powerful.

unlocks.name:
Thaumaturgic Weapons Damage: +10%
Thaumaturgic Weapons Upkeep: +5%

techs.name: Mass Neutronium Extraction
techs.description: By providing our Arkships with the means to harvest stellar remnants such as Neutron Stars, we can guarantee a reliable source of valuable alloys for aeons to come.

techs.name: Colossal Movement Systems
techs.description: The larger a ship, the harder it is to make it move. Developing new and exciting types of mega movement systems could open the door to some incredible projects.

unlocks.name: Pursuing further research into this field will unlock increasingly large warships.

techs.name: Miniature Kugelblitz Containment
techs.description: The ability to generate a Kugelblitz could prove useful, as such objects could be used as efficient singularity generators. Most importantly, controlled Kugelblitzes could be fed matter and energy for later recovery, effectively acting as a Black Hole storage device.
